nextPrompts.title: Team prompt suggestions

teamSkills.description: Offer your team's approved skills when a prompt matches one

commitLinks.title: Commit and PR links
commitLinks.description: Record the commits and PRs a session makes, and whether its PRs merged (checked with gh)

commitTrailer.title: DevScope-Session trailer
